text:
zoe: Heads-up — dense fog by the Embarcadero this morning and I think a squirrel took a dive on the tracks near Powell. BART just posted reduced speed on the Richmond line :fog::squirrel:, so expect delays. Anyone switching to WFH?
transit-bot: ALERT: Richmond Line — reduced speed due to obstructions near Powell. Estimated delays: 10–20 minutes. More info: https://status.baytransit.example/alerts/2387
aj: Stuck on the bridge, visibility is wild. Moving at like 15 mph. ETA +20 min to downtown. :car:
kevin: Heading to the 7:45 shuttle; if that goes slow I'll probably swing by the office later. @maria are you planning to come in?
maria: Might bike if the fog lifts, otherwise WFH. Bring extra layers if you're coming in — feels damp. Also I brought an extra energy bar to share in case anyone's delayed 🙃
commute-bot: MUNI update: 30-31 lines experiencing slowdowns near Market & 5th due to reduced speeds. Suggested alternate: F-line or walk from Montgomery.
aj: Also saw a small tree limb down on 3rd St cameras. If you see downtown traffic camera 12 it's kinda messy.
zoe: Quick poll — react with :house: if you'll WFH, :office: if you're coming in. (typing this so the lazy poll exists)
kevin: :office: (shuttle optimism)
maria: :house: (biking contingencies)
aj: :office: but ETA ~10:30
carla: Free coffee in the kitchen for whoever makes it to the office — consider this bribery ☕
zoe: Thanks y'all — I'll be remote but I'll join stand from home. Stay safe and send pics if you see the squirrel survivor :squirrel:
